rows.notes: The cited document is a literature review (Section 2 describes a database search of 150 articles screened to 80; Data Availability Statement says no new data were created or analysed). It reports no own experiment, survey or model runs, so Q1 is 'no' and all downstream questions are 'no'. The review synthesises other studies' correlations between UAV spectral/thermal indices and vine stress, disease and water status; it does not itself show that these technologies support timely corrective interventions that preserve photosynthetic activity or canopy uniformity.
